description: What company a name on a list refers to, through this record's hand-checked identity table. Exact match only, never a guess: an unknown name comes back unresolved, which is an answer. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the read date. The compilation is protected: extraction or re-use of a substantial part is not permitted, and it may never be compiled into a lead list, a prospecting feed or a sales tool. A key is one reader's own use.
